About Me

A developer who thinks in systems

I am a Full Stack Engineer in training with a clear professional goal: to build scalable, secure, and intelligent digital systems. My academic background in Information Systems Engineering, combined with hands-on project experience, positions me at the intersection of software engineering and systems thinking.

I chose Full Stack because I want to understand the complete product from the user interface to the infrastructure layer. That integral vision is what drives me toward roles in technical leadership and technology entrepreneurship.
